verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operation feature. The closest evidence is the 'ban all checks for a PR and stop all related agents' endpoint, which acts on several agents at once. The Python SDK and API also allow programmatic agent creation and listing of runs, so a user could script batch work themselves. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk endpoints or UI for acting on many issues, PRs or agent runs in one operation, bulk-edit examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
